scope: The same compiled full-body proposals execute 24 explicitly mapped interior sequences to a scoped status-2 checkpoint: original eight SR bank-mask sequences and sixteen DMULS/STS pairs, with full canonical-bank/MACH/MACL/register/PC/FPU/RAM/GBR and entry-state comparisons. Eight existing vector/integer-angle regressions use the extended production API with independent arithmetic checks and unchanged extra state. Three probe-API guard cases prevent production interior entry, mismatched checkpoint entry and missing extra state. The source-comment LDC audit is scoped, not a complete proof about arbitrary SR writes. This is not whole-clipper/caller/geometry, interrupt, exception-vector, timing or hardware proof; no game entries registered.
